answer: Unclear. The evidence shows multiple complaints and a 15% dissatisfaction rate with HVAC controls in the US study, so the problem exists — but none of the supplied data indicate customer age, so you cannot conclude it’s “just a habit of older customers.”
suggested_change: Remove any age-based assumption. Update the requirement to mandate that on-road usability trials report results by age group (and other key demographics) and ensure the participant sample is age-representative; acceptance should require target performance (task time and ≤8% dissatisfaction) across key age cohorts, not just overall.
